_about: Rules that generate the Hypothesis sections of a seat brief. Hypotheses are judgements that need a partner's review. They never name a person or a specific company: talent pools are company types only.

peers.Private Equity: private-equity-backed companies in the same sector
peers.Consumer Products & Retail: consumer products, durables and retail companies

finance: Indian subsidiaries of multinationals in the same sector
Private-equity-backed {peers}, where finance leaders run investor reporting
technology: Listed {peers} with an established digital function
Industry practices of IT services firms that serve {peers}
people: Indian subsidiaries of multinationals with mature HR systems
Corporate HR teams of diversified business groups
risk: Risk functions of private banks and large NBFCs
legal: Company-secretarial and legal teams of listed {peers}
Central secretarial teams of large business groups
Corporate and capital-markets practices of law firms
audit: Internal-audit teams of large listed groups
Assurance practices of the large audit firms
operations: {peers} with a comparable plant or network footprint
Contract manufacturers and outsourcing partners in the sector
Multinational subsidiaries that run large Indian operations
sales: Multinational suppliers to the same buyers
Adjacent-sector companies that sell to the same customers
general: Larger {peers}, one level below the top seat
Divisions of diversified groups in the same sector
